lineage.construction: refusal-direction ablation baked into the weights: W' = W - r r^T W applied to 40 attention and linear-attention output matrices, the down projections of all 256 experts in all 40 MoE blocks, and 40 shared experts; token embedding untouched. English direction, scale 1.0. Then quantized with the importance matrix of AtomicChat's original MiniCPM-V 4.7 quants.
lineage.quantization_layout: AD-<ffn_down>-<ffn_up>: routed experts AD-Q4_K / IQ4_XS; attention, shared expert, embedding and output head at q8_0
